messages:
Sam: heads-up — prod-eu-west3 started thrashing the autoscaler around 03:12 UTC, ~200 scale events over 15m, several GPU node pools saw readiness fail and pods stuck in Terminating; traffic started shifting to eu-west1 automatically :grimacing:
Priya: saw the same. dashboards show two distinct desired_replicas values emitted at the exact same timestamps from the router exporter after a config reload. suspicious duplication
Priya: log snippet:
```
2024-04-05T03:12:21Z router-exporter[2510]: job=ingress-abc desired_replicas=12
2024-04-05T03:12:21Z router-exporter[2510]: job=ingress-abc desired_replicas=24
2024-04-05T03:12:22Z autoscaler[controller]: reconcile request for pool=gpu-eu-west3 target=24 -> scaling
```
Luca: that looks like the exporter pushed two metric samples for the same window. did the recent observer-agent change land?
Sam: yes — we rolled the router exporter (v2.5.1) around 03:10 to include new queue_length metric. rollback started at 03:20 but there was already duplicated data buffered in redis that the metrics pipeline replayed
Maya: ops-bot routed ~30% of traffic to eu-west1 at 03:18 because node readiness dropped below threshold, so customer-facing lat p50 spiked from 300ms -> 2.1s for a few minutes :(
ops-bot: :rotating_light: failover executed: route-shift eu-west3 -> eu-west1 (partial) at 2024-04-05T03:18:12Z
Priya: mitigation steps we ran: cleared exporter buffer (redis key exporters:router:v2.5.1), disabled queue_length emission, forced autoscaler cooldown to 2m and set max-surge to 30% for gpu pools to dampen reaction
Sam: commands used:
```
redis-cli -h redis-main del exporters:router:v2.5.1
kubectl patch hpa gpu-pool-eu-west3 -p '{"spec":{"behavior":{"scaleDown":{"stabilizationWindowSeconds":120}}}}'
```
Luca: autoscaler code idea: ignore spikes where desired_replicas > last_value*1.8 within 10s window — will open a PR for conservative guardrails
Maya: opened a quick internal incident ticket and pinged support to watch customer reports. I put a short banner on status page about degraded capacity in eu-west3
Priya: followups: (1) exporter dedupe in the pipeline (2) avoid buffering unbounded in redis, add TTL + watermarking (3) add autoscaler spike-guard and circuit-breaker for duplicated metrics
Sam: postmortem: I'll own write-up, include timeline and remediation steps + cost estimate for the failover traffic (extra cross-region egress). target EOD draft
Luca: +1 — will PR autoscaler guard this afternoon
Maya: thanks all. keeping the channel for any late alerts. ops-bot: please send me aggregated error samples and any 5xx spikes when they occur :pray:
ops-bot: ack — will post a summary in 10m
Sam: thx, closing the active ops loop for now. we should be cautious about the next deploy of router-exporter.
